title: Clicking Vendors sorts lowest count first, and again highest first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own terms A and B are held by exactly 1 and 2 vendors (new terms hold only this case's vendors).
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Vendors" column heading.
  2. Click the "Vendors" column heading again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Vendors column reads from top to bottom in rising order (each number the same as or higher than the one above), with term A (1) above term B (2).

Step 2:

  • The order reverses (each number the same as or lower than the one above), with term B (2) above term A (1).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R6: “Clicking a column header sorts the table by that column, following the app-wide sorting rule: the first click sorts Name A to Z, Customers and Vendors lowest first, and Due in the S1-R5 order; each further click reverses the direction. The sort is not saved: leaving and returning to the page shows the S1-R5 order.”
